agent_cli.claude_code: claude mcp add --transport http <name> https://<host>.svatantrya.net/mcp  # authed: add --header "Authorization: Bearer $MCP_TOKEN"
agent_cli.curl_list: curl -s -X POST https://<host>.svatantrya.net/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'  # SSE framing: read data: lines
agent_cli.fastmcp:
from fastmcp import Client
async with Client('https://<host>.svatantrya.net/mcp') as c:
    tools = await c.list_tools()  # bearer hosts: Client(url, auth=BearerAuth(token))
agent_cli.inspector: npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@latest  # Transport: Streamable HTTP; URL https://<host>.svatantrya.net/mcp
agent_cli.opencode: {"mcp": {"<name>": {"type": "remote", "url": "https://<host>.svatantrya.net/mcp", "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer $MCP_TOKEN"}}}}  # drop headers for the five public hosts
